params.summary: Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 3, best version). It shows a full circle centred at O with diameter AB, vertical chord DG meeting AB at F with a verified right-angle mark, chord AC crossing DG at E, segment OE, and labels A, B, C, D, E, F, G, O. The final critic run reports no must-repair issues (assessment score 0.95, checklist score 1.0).
